integrity: Analytic proof includes all measurable and independently randomized binary encoders and complete boundary cases. Numerical verifier is corroboration, not an infinite proof. Historical priority remains provisional; binary Lloyd-Max quantization and Gaussian regression are established prior art.
scientific_limitations: Only one preselected noiseless point of standard Brownian motion and one binary message for estimating its integrated quadratic path energy under unconditional squared error; no multi-time, adaptive, noisy or other-process optimality.
title: Optimal one-bit magnitude sensing of Brownian quadratic path energy
